# Implement model provider catalog and discovery

## 任务摘要
- 类型: 开发实现（`develop`）
- 执行角色: 独立评审者（`reviewer`）
- 目标: Deliver the governed Model Catalog boundary for provider connections, discovery snapshots, snapshot-scoped probes, and exact selection: require authenticated RequestContext, scope, authorization/admission, canonical audit evidence, and mandatory scope-bound egress before credential use; atomically bind mutations to canonical audit/outbox facts, durably finalize attempted probes, reject stale publication by connection revision/digest and predecessor CAS, and contain no manual model definition, AddManualModel, manual snapshot, or manual digest authority; the immutable model-manual owner remains separate and api-model composes both owners downstream.

## 任务详情
Authoring recovery for the existing model-catalog delivery: consume the canonical RequestContext, authorization/admission, AuditEvent, and Credential contracts; remove production bypasses and every duplicate manual model/snapshot/digest path from core; and close the rejected concurrency, recovery, provenance, and fail-closed transport boundaries without changing adjacent owners or requiring an unmaterialized upstream artifact.

## 非目标
- Do not modify internal/modelcatalog/manual/**, migrate model-manual ownership, consume or regenerate a model-manual component manifest, or define Model, Snapshot, AddManualModel, manual merge, or manual content digest behavior inside model-catalog. Do not create a conformance-artifact handoff when the authoritative removal option eliminates that input; any supplied model-manual artifact is outside the explicit `consumes: []` boundary and must fail closed.
- Do not move RequestContext, authorization, admission, canonical AuditEvent, CredentialBroker, or durable outbox ownership into model-catalog, and do not introduce feature-local replacements for those platform facts.
- Do not retain exported ungoverned production constructors, fallback actor/scope paths, origin-only default egress, credential materialization before policy approval, or public concrete store writers that bypass the governed application protocol.
- Do not persist caller-controlled raw strings as non-secret headers, place Secret material in connection state or digests, leak credentials or raw provider errors, or weaken fail-closed classification at the HTTP adapter.
- Do not publish a snapshot without atomic current-connection revision/configuration-digest and predecessor checks, key probe evidence without ModelCatalogSnapshotID, or leave an attempted provider call as an unrecoverable in-progress claim.
- Do not add a generic provider/plugin runtime, make an external provider the source of truth, change northbound API/UI ownership, or broaden source ownership beyond internal/modelcatalog/core/** and internal/modelcatalog/providers/** plus exact tests and generated evidence.

blocker_facts.summary: A provider timeout returns before saving a failed/unknown probe, leaving an older success selectable.
blocker_facts.evidence: providers/http.go:119-127 maps timeout to context.DeadlineExceeded; application.go:367-370 returns before probe persistence; selection accepts the old successful key.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Persist a redacted failed/unknown observation or invalidate prior success and define safe retry semantics for an unknown external outcome.

blocker_facts.summary: SelectModel ignores requested snapshot provenance and resolves LatestSnapshot.
blocker_facts.evidence: application.go:398-450 reads LatestSnapshot at line 409 and never consumes SelectModelRequest.ModelCatalogSnapshotID.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Separate browse-latest from exact resolution and require a stable snapshot plus fixed revision/digest for materialization.

blocker_facts.summary: Exact selection checks only Probe.Outcome after FindProbe and not the returned provenance fields.
blocker_facts.evidence: application.go:427-436 trusts the store result; ProbeKey at types.go:445-450 defines the fields that must match.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Validate and compare connection, revision, digest, model, and API type on every returned probe.

blocker_facts.summary: Sensitive non-secret headers are protected by an incomplete denylist.
blocker_facts.evidence: core/types.go:725-748 and providers/http.go:155-190 accept unlisted credential-bearing header names and values that are persisted and transmitted.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Use an explicit safe-header allowlist or typed CredentialBinding mapping at both core and adapter boundaries, with regression tests.

blocker_facts.summary: The PR duplicates manual snapshot merge/validation beside the existing manual package.
blocker_facts.evidence: internal/modelcatalog/manual/manual.go:62-232 and core/application.go:243-284,567-592 define separate manual publication behavior and core/types.go:249-367 defines a second digest contract.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Select one canonical manual snapshot contract and adapt or retire the other implementation.

blocker_facts.summary: Governed commands lack authenticated RequestContext, authorization/admission, and canonical audit ownership.
blocker_facts.evidence: core/types.go:171-193 accepts scope/actor fields from input; application.go:54-117 writes directly; no authorization/audit port exists.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Derive scope and actor from authenticated context, invoke authorization/admission, and emit connection and credential-use audit evidence.

blocker_facts.summary: Manual fallback copies discovered entries across changed connection provenance.
blocker_facts.evidence: application.go:261-275 loads prior snapshot without provenance filtering; manualSuccessorModels at 567-592 clones every prior model.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Carry forward only manual/mixed entries when revision/configuration changes; retain discovered entries only with matching provenance.

blocker_facts.summary: HTTP connectors can use an unrestricted default client against any HTTP(S) host and follow redirects.
blocker_facts.evidence: core/types.go:710-722 validates only URI shape; providers/http.go:42-60 defaults to &http.Client{} and 99-119 sends without an egress/origin policy.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Require a scope-bound policy-enforcing resolver/transport and reject or validate redirects before credential injection.

blocker_facts.summary: Connector-supplied sanitized error fields and ProviderError summaries are persisted without central redaction.
blocker_facts.evidence: application.go:367-380 and 654-660 copy connector fields; types.go:426-431 checks formatting only, not safe content or cardinality.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Use typed low-cardinality error categories or central fail-closed sanitization before persistence and exposure.

blocker_facts.summary: Read-then-append snapshot publication has no predecessor CAS or idempotency.
blocker_facts.evidence: application.go:220-235 and 268-283 read LatestSnapshot then SaveSnapshot; store.go:99-118 only appends, so concurrent manual updates can lose entries.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Add atomic expected-predecessor publication and stable command idempotency, including test-message retry semantics.

blocker_facts.summary: A caller context deadline still returns before persisting an unknown probe, so an older successful probe can remain selectable.
blocker_facts.evidence: internal/modelcatalog/core/application.go:459-470 returns immediately when ctx.Err() is context.DeadlineExceeded; probe persistence occurs only at :485-495, while selection accepts ProbeSucceeded at :563-572.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Persist a redacted ProbeUnknown observation for any provider timeout after the attempt may have started, including a parent-context deadline; distinguish only a preflight cancellation that is known not to have reached the provider.
blocker_facts.last_evidence: Internal connector timeouts now persist ProbeUnknown, but the parent-context deadline branch still returns before persistence.

blocker_facts.summary: Exact SelectModel is pinned, but alternate probe/materialization paths still expose moving LatestSnapshot semantics.
blocker_facts.evidence: SelectModel now uses Store.Snapshot, but SendTestMessage falls back to Store.LatestSnapshot when ModelCatalogSnapshotID is blank at internal/modelcatalog/core/application.go:387-392, and LatestSnapshot remains a public SnapshotStore operation at types.go:789-795.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Keep LatestSnapshot exclusively in explicit browse/current-catalog operations; require an exact snapshot/provenance for any command whose evidence can be consumed by materialization, or make the current choice explicit and non-replayable.
blocker_facts.last_evidence: SelectModel now pins Store.Snapshot, but SendTestMessage still falls back to LatestSnapshot when no snapshot ID is supplied and the public store port still exposes moving latest reads to alternate callers.

blocker_facts.summary: SendTestMessage returns a prior idempotent probe before checking that its connection, revision, digest, model, and API type match the current request.
blocker_facts.evidence: internal/modelcatalog/core/application.go:407-417 returns FindProbeByIdempotency results directly; provenance validation exists only later at :881-892 during selection. internal/modelcatalog/core/store.go:263-273 indexes probe commands by the raw idempotency key without a request digest.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Bind idempotency to an operation-scoped request digest covering connection/provenance/model/API type and the test command; reject key reuse with different evidence, validate the stored result before returning it, and reserve the key atomically before the external call to prevent concurrent duplicates.
blocker_facts.last_evidence: Selection now calls validateProbeProvenance, but SendTestMessage returns FindProbeByIdempotency results before that validation and the raw key is not bound to the current request provenance.

blocker_facts.summary: Governed commands report audit failure after the domain write has already committed.
blocker_facts.evidence: CreateConnection and UpdateConnection call Store.CreateConnection/UpdateConnection before recordAudit; discovery, manual publication, probe save, and selection follow the same post-write audit pattern in internal/modelcatalog/core/application.go:285-290, :344-350, :488-502, and :583-587.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Use the canonical audit authority as part of the same durable transaction or append an idempotent outbox/evidence record with the domain mutation; do not return a failed command after a committed change without a recoverable audit fact.

blocker_facts.summary: The name allowlist rejects unknown headers but does not provide a typed/value-level secret boundary for the allowlisted map.
blocker_facts.evidence: ValidateNonSecretHeaders checks header names and newlines at internal/modelcatalog/core/application.go:930-941; values for X-Tenant, X-Workspace-Id, X-Project-Id, and X-Request-Id are still persisted and included in ConfigurationDigest without a typed non-secret value contract.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Use typed non-secret metadata values with policy validation, or move all caller-supplied headers behind explicit CredentialBinding/typed bindings; preserve the same fail-closed rule in the adapter.
blocker_facts.last_evidence: The narrow name allowlist rejects arbitrary connection headers, but allowed header values remain untyped caller-controlled strings that are persisted and included in the configuration digest without a value-level secret contract.

blocker_facts.summary: The PR changes the separately owned model-manual package and still leaves an independently callable reduced Snapshot contract outside the packaged model-catalog component.
blocker_facts.evidence: The PR changes internal/modelcatalog/manual/manual.go and manual_test.go, while contracts/release/source-ownership-baseline.yaml:296-304 assigns internal/modelcatalog/core and providers to model-catalog and internal/modelcatalog/manual to model-manual. blocker_facts.required_fix: Do not modify the model-manual owner from this PR; coordinate a separate owner-approved adapter/removal, or amend the ownership/contract and package the adapter explicitly. If the compatibility API remains, make its conformance and lifecycle boundary explicit rather than retaining a second independently writable snapshot contract.
blocker_facts.last_evidence: Core owns a canonical merge projection, but the PR still changes and retains a separately owned manual Snapshot/AddManualModel API and does not package that changed owner source.

blocker_facts.summary: The unsafe ungoverned constructor remains production-capable, and its audit boundary is not fail-closed with the mutation.
blocker_facts.evidence: internal/modelcatalog/core/application.go:863-895 leaves NewApplication/NewDefaultApplication usable without Governance; in that mode caller-supplied ScopeID/CreatedBy/UpdatedBy are accepted. Create/update persist at :102-105 and :157-160 before recordAudit at :736-750 can fail. The local ModelCatalogAuditEvent DTO at internal/modelcatalog/core/types.go:746-775 is not the canonical audit.AuditEvent fact defined by contracts/governance/audit/audit.go:53-81.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Make the production application boundary require authenticated RequestContext, authorization, admission, and the canonical audit owner; isolate any ungoverned test helper explicitly. Commit the mutation and audit fact atomically through the owning Platform Core transaction/outbox, or otherwise guarantee that a failed audit cannot leave an unaudited write.

blocker_facts.summary: Manual/mixed carry-forward across an API-type change can retain the old model API type in the new snapshot.
blocker_facts.evidence: manualSuccessorModelsForConnection carries prior manual/mixed entries at internal/modelcatalog/core/application.go:823-829 without updating APIType; SendTestMessage and SelectModel reject a model/API-type mismatch at :404-405 and :554-555, leaving a current snapshot with unusable carried entries.

blocker_facts.last_evidence: Discovered carry-forward is filtered by provenance, but manual/mixed entries survive an API-type change with their old APIType and remain in the current snapshot even though test/selection rejects them as incompatible.

blocker_facts.summary: The default egress control is not scope-bound and is evaluated only after a short-lived credential lease has been resolved.
blocker_facts.evidence: internal/modelcatalog/providers/http.go:50-72 installs configuredOriginPolicy by default, which only compares scheme/host and checks that ScopeID is non-empty; arbitrary HTTP(S) BaseURI values remain accepted by internal/modelcatalog/core/types.go:911-923. The application resolves credentials at core/application.go:253-262 and :423-427 before providers/http.go:112-117 evaluates EgressPolicy. Redirect following is disabled, but policy enforcement is not required at construction.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Require a scope/platform policy-enforcing resolver or transport in the governed constructor, fail closed when absent, enforce it before credential resolution/injection, and retain redirect rejection or revalidation against the same policy.
blocker_facts.last_evidence: Redirect following is blocked and a policy seam exists, but the default policy accepts any configured origin and is evaluated after credential resolution.

blocker_facts.summary: SendTestMessage can return a connector-supplied error verbatim on timeout paths even though stored probe fields are canonicalized.
blocker_facts.evidence: The timeout branches return connectorErr directly at internal/modelcatalog/core/application.go:459-465 and :504-505; ProviderError.Error exposes its Summary at types.go:722-735. The connector port accepts arbitrary implementations, so a wrapped timeout can carry unredacted text to the caller.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Return only canonical context/provider error categories from every application path, including unknown-timeout responses; never return a connector error object directly across the application boundary.
blocker_facts.last_evidence: Stored probe fields are canonicalized through SafeProviderError, but SendTestMessage returns connectorErr directly on timeout paths, so an arbitrary connector can still expose a wrapped unredacted summary.

blocker_facts.summary: The canonical store interface still exposes a non-CAS SaveSnapshot writer, and test messages may opt out of idempotency.
blocker_facts.evidence: internal/modelcatalog/core/types.go:789-810 includes SaveSnapshot and SaveProbe alongside the guarded methods; internal/modelcatalog/core/store.go:104-124 appends snapshots without a predecessor or idempotency check. internal/modelcatalog/core/application.go:488-495 calls SaveProbe when IdempotencyKey is blank.

contract.objective: Deliver the governed Model Catalog boundary for provider connections, discovery snapshots, snapshot-scoped probes, and exact selection: require authenticated RequestContext, scope, authorization/admission, canonical audit evidence, and mandatory scope-bound egress before credential use; atomically bind mutations to canonical audit/outbox facts, durably finalize attempted probes, reject stale publication by connection revision/digest and predecessor CAS, and contain no manual model definition, AddManualModel, manual snapshot, or manual digest authority; the immutable model-manual owner remains separate and api-model composes both owners downstream.
non_goals: Do not modify internal/modelcatalog/manual/**, migrate model-manual ownership, consume or regenerate a model-manual component manifest, or define Model, Snapshot, AddManualModel, manual merge, or manual content digest behavior inside model-catalog. Do not create a conformance-artifact handoff when the authoritative removal option eliminates that input; any supplied model-manual artifact is outside the explicit `consumes: []` boundary and must fail closed.

Do not move RequestContext, authorization, admission, canonical AuditEvent, CredentialBroker, or durable outbox ownership into model-catalog, and do not introduce feature-local replacements for those platform facts.

Do not retain exported ungoverned production constructors, fallback actor/scope paths, origin-only default egress, credential materialization before policy approval, or public concrete store writers that bypass the governed application protocol.

Do not persist caller-controlled raw strings as non-secret headers, place Secret material in connection state or digests, leak credentials or raw provider errors, or weaken fail-closed classification at the HTTP adapter.

Do not publish a snapshot without atomic current-connection revision/configuration-digest and predecessor checks, key probe evidence without ModelCatalogSnapshotID, or leave an attempted provider call as an unrecoverable in-progress claim.

Do not add a generic provider/plugin runtime, make an external provider the source of truth, change northbound API/UI ownership, or broaden source ownership beyond internal/modelcatalog/core/** and internal/modelcatalog/providers/** plus exact tests and generated evidence.
